newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING'S POSTBANK SAYS TO HIKE MORTGAGE RATES.
newsitem.headline: ING'S POSTBANK SAYS TO HIKE MORTGAGE RATES.

text.p: Postbank, a banking unit of ING , said on Thursday it would raise its mortgage rates for fixed-interest loans of three years and longer by 0.4 percent, effective from Friday.

"Effective from 28 March 1997, the Postbank will raise its mortgage rates by 0.4 percent for Postbank mortgages with a fixed-rate interest period of three years and longer," Postbank said in a statement.
The Postbank move follows a similar hike by Rabobank Nederland, which raised the interest rate on its five-year fixed interest mortgages to 6.1 percent from 5.7 percent on Wednesday.
Rabobank, the Netherlands' largest mortgage provider, said yesterday it was lifting long-term mortgage rates in the wake of rising capital market interest rates.
The increase follows last week's wave of rate hikes on short-term mortgages by the major banks.
